title: Generate initial random supercell
action: Create a cubic supercell containing 62 Ni atoms and 38 Nb atoms with random positions. Use periodic boundary conditions.
description: Prepare the initial configuration for AIMD from the given composition.

title: Run AIMD simulation of liquid Ni62Nb38
action: Perform ab initio molecular dynamics in the NVT ensemble using the PBE functional and appropriate pseudopotentials. Heat the supercell to 2500 K and equilibrate, then cool to the target temperatures 1873 K, 1473 K, 1403 K, and 1233 K, collecting production trajectories at each temperature.
description: Generate equilibrium trajectories at four temperatures; these trajectories are the basis for all subsequent analysis.

title: Compute electronic density of states (DOS)
action: Using a snapshot from the production runs at 1873 K and 1233 K, run a static DFT calculation with higher plane-wave cutoff to obtain the total and projected (Ni s,p,d; Nb s,p,d) density of states.
description: Electronic structure calculation required to explain Ni–Nb bonding.

title: Analyze structure, dynamics and electronic properties
action: From the trajectories and DOS data, compute for each temperature: total pair distribution function g(r) up to 10 Å, total structure factor S(q) up to 10 Å⁻¹, bond-angle distributions for all triple types, partial coordination numbers and Warren-Cowley CSRO parameters, mean square displacements and self-diffusion coefficients via Einstein relation, and the full density of states (energy, total and projected). Package all results into a single JSON file.
description: Central scored artifact containing all structural, dynamic, and electronic properties that the checker will verify against hidden paper-reported trends.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'temperatures' (list of 4 floats in K), 'total_g_r' (list of dicts per temperature with 'r' (Å) and 'g' arrays), 'total_S_q' (list of dicts per temperature with 'q' (Å⁻¹) and 'S' arrays), 'bond_angle_distributions' (dict mapping bond type string to list of dicts per temperature with 'angle' (deg) and 'probability' arrays), 'csro_parameters' (list of dicts per temperature with keys 'Ni-Ni','Ni-Nb','Nb-Ni','Nb-Nb'), 'diffusion_coefficients' (list of dicts per temperature with keys 'D_Ni','D_Nb','D_total' in units of 1e-4 cm²/s), 'dos' (list of dicts for 1873 K and 1233 K with 'energy' (eV, Fermi level=0), 'total_dos','Ni_d','Nb_d','Ni_s','Ni_p','Nb_s','Nb_p' arrays).
